nodes.name: test_dashboard_holdings_route.py

nodes.name: test_dashboard_routes.py
nodes.summary: API-level tests for the household-members endpoints: auth requirement, create-then-list round trip, and per-user scoping so one user cannot see another's members.

nodes.name: test_dashboard_sips_route.py
nodes.summary: API-level tests for the dashboard SIPs route: auth requirement and the empty-list case for a member with no active SIPs.

nodes.name: test_dashboard_snapshots_route.py
nodes.summary: API-level tests for the dashboard portfolio-snapshots route: auth requirement and the empty-list case for a member with no transactions.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Shared pytest configuration: tags tests under functional_postgres/ with the 'postgres' marker so the fast SQLite suite can skip them, and provides the `client` fixture — a FastAPI TestClient wired to an isolated in-memory SQLite DB via dependency override.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses StaticPool with a single shared in-memory SQLite connection so every request in a test sees the same data, and autoflush=False to mirror the production session config.

nodes.name: test_partitioning.py
nodes.summary: Postgres-only functional tests (marked `pytest.mark.postgres`, skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL) that confirm the transactions and nav_history tables are actually declared as partitioned after an Alembic upgrade, and that the ORM's enum handling round-trips correctly through the partitioned transactions table.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs `alembic downgrade base` then `alembic upgrade head` via subprocess against a real Postgres URL to test partitioning DDL that SQLite (used by the fast suite) cannot express.

nodes.name: test_enrich.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the CAS scheme-enrichment service (`MfApiClient`): trusting the CAS-supplied AMFI code, fuzzy-matching scheme names when no code is present, marking low-confidence matches pending, scheme-category lookups, graceful degradation when mfapi.in is unreachable, and disk-cache read/write behavior for scheme categories.

nodes.name: test_migrations.py
nodes.summary: Tests that exercise the Alembic migration chain directly against a throwaway SQLite DB: full upgrade/downgrade round trip, that upgrade creates every expected table, that the transactions dedupe unique constraint gains the `type` column on upgrade and loses it on downgrade to 0001, and that a percent-encoded credential in DATABASE_URL doesn't crash Alembic's configparser interpolation.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives Alembic via subprocess against real SQLite files rather than mocking, and inspects SQLite's PRAGMA index_list/index_info to assert on the actual unique-constraint columns post-migration.

nodes.name: tokens.css
nodes.summary: CSS custom-property design tokens (colors, typography scale, spacing, radii, shadows, motion) sourced directly from Design-Schema-Unifolio.md — the single source of truth consumed by every other stylesheet and CSS module in the app.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the frontend SPA, enabling the official React plugin.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test-runner configuration: jsdom environment, global test APIs enabled, and setupTests.ts registered as the setup file.

nodes.name: test_create_and_list_household_member
nodes.summary: Verifies POSTing a new household member succeeds and the member subsequently appears when listing household members for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: client
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture that builds a FastAPI TestClient backed by an isolated in-memory SQLite DB (StaticPool, autoflush=False) and overrides the app's get_db dependency, tearing the override down after the test.

nodes.name: test_transactions_and_nav_history_are_partitioned
nodes.summary: After a full Alembic downgrade/upgrade cycle against a real Postgres DB, queries pg_partitioned_table directly to assert that transactions and nav_history are genuinely declared as partitioned tables.

nodes.name: test_transaction_orm_insert_round_trips_on_partitioned_table
nodes.summary: Builds a full user/member/scheme/folio/import/transaction fixture chain against Postgres to verify the ORM sends the TransactionType enum's lowercase `.value` correctly, satisfying the partitioned table's raw CHECK (type IN (...)) constraint, and that the inserted row round-trips intact on refetch.

nodes.name: test_get_scheme_category_happy_path
nodes.summary: Verifies MfApiClient.get_scheme_category returns the expected SEBI category when the underlying mfapi.in JSON lookup succeeds.

nodes.name: test_disk_cache_read_write_for_scheme_category
nodes.summary: Confirms scheme-category lookups are written to and served from the on-disk cache: after a first call populates the cache file, a second call with the mock reset does not re-hit the network, proving the cache short-circuits repeat lookups.

nodes.name: test_alembic_upgrade_and_downgrade_round_trip
nodes.summary: Runs `alembic upgrade head` then `alembic downgrade base` against a fresh SQLite DB and asserts both subprocess calls succeed, proving the full migration chain is reversible.

nodes.name: test_alembic_upgrade_creates_all_tables
nodes.summary: Runs a full Alembic upgrade against SQLite and asserts every expected table (users, transactions, nav_history, portfolio_snapshots, fund_scores, etc.) exists in sqlite_master afterward.

nodes.name: test_transaction_dedupe_constraint_includes_type_after_upgrade
nodes.summary: Verifies the transactions table's unique dedupe constraint gains the `type` column after upgrading to head (folio_id, date, amount, units, type) and reverts to the pre-fix column set (without type) after downgrading to migration 0001, by inspecting PRAGMA index_list/index_info directly.

nodes.name: test_alembic_handles_percent_in_database_url
nodes.summary: Uses a DATABASE_URL containing a literal '%' character to ensure Alembic's env.py doesn't crash with configparser's ValueError: invalid interpolation syntax, for both upgrade and downgrade.
